Privacy Policy

PageCrew (https://pagecrew.vercel.app)
Last updated: 2 October 2026

PageCrew is a tool that lets you connect your Facebook account and create, schedule and publish posts on your Facebook Pages from one place. This policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.

1. Data we collect

When you click "Connect Facebook" and approve the permissions, we receive from Facebook:

  • Your public profile information (name and Facebook user ID).
  • The list of Facebook Pages you manage (Page name, Page ID and picture).
  • Page access tokens for the Pages you choose to connect.

We also store the posts you create in PageCrew (text, media links, schedule time and publish status).

2. How we use the data

  • To show your Pages inside PageCrew.
  • To publish or schedule posts to the Pages you select, on your request only.
  • To show you the status of your posts (scheduled, published or failed).

We do not sell your data, do not share it with advertisers, and do not use it for any purpose other than providing this service.

3. Facebook permissions

We request only the permissions needed to list your Pages and to publish content on them on your behalf. We do not post anything without your action in PageCrew.

4. Storage and security

Your data is stored in a secured database. Access tokens are used only by our server to call the Facebook API and are never shown to other users. We take reasonable measures to protect your data, but no online system is completely secure.

5. Data sharing

We share data only with Facebook (Meta), as needed to perform the actions you request, and with our hosting and database providers who process data on our behalf. We may disclose data if required by law.

6. Data retention and deletion

We keep your data until you disconnect your account or ask us to delete it. You can remove PageCrew at any time from Facebook (Settings & privacy > Settings > Business Integrations) and request deletion of your data as described at https://pagecrew.vercel.app/data-deletion.html.

7. Children

PageCrew is not intended for people under 18.

8. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available at this URL.

9. Contact

For questions or data requests, email: YOUR_EMAIL@example.com
